metadata.title: Enumeration of one-cycle signed chord diagrams and their duals for optimal Morse flows on closed surfaces
metadata.abstract: Optimal Morse vector fields on closed surfaces, i.e.\ fields with the minimal possible number of critical points (a single source and a single sink), are classified up to topological trajectory equivalence by one-cycle signed chord diagrams in Kybalko, Prishlyak and Shchurko (2018). We recall this construction and the associated duality, which corresponds to reversing the direction of the flow, in a unified encoding in which both endpoints of a chord carry the same label, and we make it algorithmic. We give an explicit traversal procedure that detects one-cycle diagrams, a canonical form of an equivalence class under cyclic shifts, reversal and relabeling of chords, and a construction of the dual diagram. On this basis we describe an algorithm that enumerates all one-cycle signed chord diagrams with a given number of chords, both for orientable and for non-orientable surfaces, groups them into equivalence classes, pairs each class with its dual, and identifies the self-dual ones. The algorithm is implemented in Python and archived in Zenodo; its output is validated against the Harer--Zagier numbers in the orientable case and against orbit-size counts in both cases. We also note that, when a one-cycle diagram is read as a cellular embedding of a one-vertex graph, its dual diagram describes the embedding of the dual graph.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 将闭曲面上最优 Morse 向量场对应的单圈带符号弦图统一编码，给出判定、规范化、对偶及自对偶枚举算法，并用 Harer–Zagier 数与轨道大小核验 Python 实现。
analysis.breakthrough: 把既有分类转化为可复现的枚举流程，同时记录反向流对应的对偶。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。不是重新建立全部 Morse 向量场分类；程序与验证数据尚未独立执行复核。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
analysis.priorityReason: 按与几何研究的关联、结论范围和可迁移方法安排阅读；不是重新建立全部 Morse 向量场分类；程序与验证数据尚未独立执行复核。
